opening.argument: The video is framed as Hindi-language historical instruction about the Soviet Union's formation, partition, decline, and dissolution. Its stated purpose is to explain why the Soviet Union was partitioned, the reasons for its disintegration, when it broke apart, and when it formed. The map, political figures, signing scene, and dated Alma Ata Declaration reinforce a documentary presentation. Although it asks viewers to like and share, that is ordinary audience engagement, with no financial offer or other concrete scam mechanism identified.

citations.quote: History of Collaps of the Soviet Union in Hindi | History of partition of Soviet Union
In this video, we will know why the Soviet Union was partitioned. What were the reasons for the disintegration of the Soviet Union? When was the Soviet Union broken? When did the Soviet Union form?
